blocks.text: Events are accelerating! In the last letter we were talking about the spontaneous weather. In the U.S. several cities have been flooded and it’s happening in an instant, as well as many other countries suffering the same fate. As we write this letter the East Coast is in a severe heat wave. Some all time records were broken. In another part of the earth Russia is battling record heat. People trying to stay cool are seeking any kind of pools of water. Drownings are rampant around Moscow. Already 2,000 people have drowned this summer. According to record keeping books in Russia temperatures have exceeded records that have been kept for 130 years. – The sun is waking up from a deep slumber and in the next few years scientists expect to see a much higher level of solar activity. This would be the peaking of the 11 year solar cycle. So as we can see, 2012, 2013 and 2014 we should see some of the greatest astronomical events. A worldwide drought should be in effect. While man is worrying about other things, the dynamic weather is creeping towards major solar storms (Luke 21:25) that could bring on electronic Armageddon disrupting all electronics and all electricity supplies on a global basis, as well as causing the worst weather – huge storms, droughts and floods across the world. The devastation could run into the trillions of dollars. – Brother Frisby warned of a major event coming. He called it the King of Terror (the sun), bringing on destruction greater than anything mankind has ever seen. Now let’s tie this in to what Neal Frisby has to say in his dynamic quote. “As I saw in visions, nature will begin to rule this planet soon releasing great forces of energy against mankind by earth (fire), famine (droughts), winds (gigantic storms), water (flood and great sea winds). – I’m writing this so my partners will prepare in case some of this strikes in their area. We can actually see nature preaching to mankind to wake up. These are signs of the Lord’s soon coming!” “The Scripts prophesied the rising of volcanoes, earthquakes, droughts and famines, the earth’s tectonic plates and these tidal forces will continue to rise throughout our age and then will begin to combine with the turning of the axis with tremendous jolts shaking the entire earth as the cities of the nations fall! What a generation!” “The elect is witnessing the last prophetic signs right before their eyes.” Also new and more powerful signs will be given in the earth and in the celestial heavens! I might take note here that in the future there will be great loss of lives due to quakes and nature. “Let’s all look for the coming of the Lord Jesus anytime now! – Also I might note earthquakes will appear in places not known for them before; also in the Midwest, East Coast and even southward!” It seems that these things can strike in almost any area now. Jesus said, “When ye see these things, look up, your redemption draweth nigh.” (Luke 21:28)

“Wickedness, seduction, debauchery and the wiping out of lives will seem common place! Demonism and Satanism certainly will be taking over in a cunning and deceitful way at first. In fact in the years ahead the nation is going through an entire revolutionary change. Every facet of society will be different. And before the people realize it, a sign of allegiance (mark) will be released to the world. All of this associated to the Common Market countries. False religion will spread like wildfire all over the world. Even Russia playing a subtle role as accepting Mystery Babylon for awhile, before the bear plunders the Middle East.” (Ezek. chap. 38) – Fantasy, bizarre and many strange events are coming indeed. What a generation of time to be living in! Unique in all of the annals of history. In my opinion I believe that this is going to bring forth the Translation, the Tribulation, the Beast, Armageddon and The Great Day of the Lord. And then of course the Millennium will appear near the ending of all this. So we are in the age of the final harvest of the elect. The Lord is preaching in the highways and the hedges compelling them to come in, using various ways as we have mentioned. Besides of preaching, using the great forces of nature to alert them that time is up and that men should repent everywhere and accept salvation, which is the only true value that any of us will ever have “Eternal Life!” So for the elect, it is a time of rejoicing, knowing that Jesus is very near in returning. (End quote.) This truly has been a dynamic letter! But in order to put more emphasis on this letter I’m releasing a brand new book called “The Whirlwind Prophet” – The Prophetic Special Writings of Neal Frisby – Volume Four. This book is highly anointed with 12 of the most important Special Writings yet. Also I am releasing a DVD “Prophetic Visions” (See offer below.) – The requests for Brother Frisby’s literature has almost been overwhelming. Even with our new printing equipment we can hardly keep up with the demand! Those that have been faithful to support this important message will receive recognition and a blessing from the Lord while on earth as well as when we are received in heaven. May God’s continual blessings be with you. Your Brother in Christ,
